recommendation_profile.primary_thesis: 3C Lotus Panache is a high-performing delivered residential society offering excellent construction quality, complete RERA clearance, and 80%+ open green spaces.
recommendation_profile.timeline_advice: Ideal for immediate end-use occupancy or stable monthly rental income generation.
negotiation_leverage: Target 3-5% price negotiation on resale units based on interior floor condition.

decision_profile.decision_thesis: 3C Lotus Panache is a high-conviction residential asset in Sector 110, offering balanced price-to-quality ratios and strong livability metrics.
why_buy: Strategic location in Sector 110, Noida with high capital appreciation potential.
Quality construction by The 3C Company with comprehensive modern lifestyle amenities.
Strong connectivity to major expressways, commercial business hubs, and proposed infrastructure.
why_avoid: Proposed Greater Noida West Metro extension is currently in planning/tender stage; transit currently relies on road transport.
Parthala flyover entry point experiences slow vehicle movement during evening peak return commute.
decision_profile.best_for: Families, corporate professionals, and long-term capital appreciation investors.
decision_profile.not_ideal_for: Buyers seeking purely short-term speculative flipping under 12 months.
